# Convert a Data Frame to a Named List of Vectors

Convert a Data Frame to a Named List of Vectors

## Usage

``` r
df2list(df, name_col, value_col, clean_names = FALSE)
```

## Arguments

- df:

  Data frame to be converted.

- name_col:

  Character. Name of the column in `df` to be used for list names.

- value_col:

  Character. Name of the column in `df` to be used as list elements
  (vectors).

- clean_names:

  Logical. Should list names be modified to remove whitespaces and
  non-aphanumeric strings (excluding underscores)? See
  [`SomaDataIO::cleanNames()`](https://somalogic.github.io/SomaDataIO/reference/cleanNames.html)
  for more details.

## Value

A list of vectors.

## Author

Amanda Hiser

## Examples

``` r
df <- SomaDataIO::rn2col(SomaDataIO::example_data, "Rowname")
df2list(df, name_col = "SampleType", value_col = "Rowname")
```
